slides: 1. Men with a real career are rare
A man with direction, money and something to show for it is hard to find. Most guys are still figuring it out or making excuses. That's why a man who has his life together stands out so fast.
Pretty faces and good bodies are common. You see them on apps, in cafes, on Instagram, almost anywhere you look. Beauty isn't the scarce thing. Success is.
When a man has status, money and a strong frame, several women start going after him. They show more interest, invest more and try harder. This isn't theory. It happens every single day.
Stop complaining that women only want successful guys. Become one. Build the career, the body, the income and the lifestyle, until women are the ones chasing you.
If you have nothing unique to offer, you stay in the huge pool of forgettable guys. Successful men step out of that pool, and that's when the attention and the options grow.
closing: Save this for the day you want to quit.
